ui.title: Identity service unavailable · smoke · Page entry and navigation
ui.preconditions: Signed-out visitor or controlled identity-provider state; backing data Keycloak OIDC availability state.
steps: Simulate an identity-provider initialization error.
Render the identity-service error state and verify the message and Retry button.
Check the page-specific heading and primary control and confirm no private data is exposed to the wrong account.
ui.expected: The Identity service unavailable lifecycle screen behaves as expected: Render the identity-service error state and verify the message and Retry button. No unauthorized workspace data is displayed.
ui.evidence: Capture screenshot on failure; retain Playwright video and trace on failure.

bdd.scenario: Identity service unavailable: the identity provider is unavailable
bdd.given: Given a visitor is on the Nexora account lifecycle
bdd.when: When the identity provider is unavailable
bdd.then: Then a clear service error and retry action are shown
bdd.and: And the result is consistent with Keycloak OIDC availability state and the configured identity/session state
bdd.testData: Use the configured test identity only; do not use real customer credentials.

bdd.scenario: Identity service unavailable: the identity provider becomes available
bdd.given: Given a visitor is on the Nexora account lifecycle
bdd.when: When the identity provider becomes available
bdd.then: Then retry reloads the authentication check
bdd.and: And the result is consistent with Keycloak OIDC availability state and the configured identity/session state
bdd.testData: Use the configured test identity only; do not use real customer credentials.

bdd.scenario: Identity service unavailable: the identity provider remains unavailable after retry
bdd.given: Given a visitor is on the Nexora account lifecycle
bdd.when: When the identity provider remains unavailable after retry
bdd.then: Then the error remains visible and the visitor stays signed out
bdd.and: And the result is consistent with Keycloak OIDC availability state and the configured identity/session state
bdd.testData: Use the configured test identity only; do not use real customer credentials.

bdd.scenario: Identity service unavailable: the identity provider recovers after a failed attempt
bdd.given: Given a visitor is on the Nexora account lifecycle
bdd.when: When the identity provider recovers after a failed attempt
bdd.then: Then retry reaches the sign-in screen
bdd.and: And the result is consistent with Keycloak OIDC availability state and the configured identity/session state
bdd.testData: Use the configured test identity only; do not use real customer credentials.
